Archival Dispatch: 22 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Edgar Bergen & Charlie McCarthy, Buck Rogers, Family Doctor, and Country Music Time

Batch 58 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 58 resolves 22 historical radio broadcasts spanning legendary network comedy, pioneering science-fiction radio serials, syndicated medical human-interest drama, and military recruitment country music: 6 landmark broadcasts from The Edgar Bergen & Charlie McCarthy Show (1939–1956, featuring historic appearances by Fred Allen, Abbott & Costello, W.C. Fields, Ida Lupino, and their 20th Anniversary retrospective), 6 episodes of the classic 1939 juvenile sci-fi serial Buck Rogers in the 25th Century (featuring Dr. Huer's Mechanical Mole and the search for Killer Kane near Pluto), 8 syndicated episodes of Family Doctor (starring Grant Richards as small-town physician Dr. Jim Adams, 1938), and 2 musical variety broadcasts from Country Music Time (featuring The Willis Brothers and Spike Jones & His City Slickers).

1. The Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy Show (1939–1956)

Radio's highest-rated comedy program throughout the Golden Age:
